title: AikiField — The Security Leadership Assessment
author: AikiField
exact_source_text: The Security Leadership Assessment. Measure your security maturity and the leadership presence capabilities that sustain it. Two assessments in one. The first measures your organization's security maturity. The second measures the leadership presence capabilities that determine whether your program holds up under pressure. On a scale of 1–6 (6 being high), how well, how much, or how often do you... There are no right answers. The purpose is honest self-inquiry — to diagnose where you are, envision where you want to go, and design a practice that gets you there. Part 1: Security Maturity Assessment. Five categories measuring your organization's security posture, controls, and readiness. Governance & Strategy, Product & Engineering Security, DevSecOps & Vulnerability Remediation.
